question_or_hypothesis: Can independent reviewers using the versioned rules distinguish duplicates and surface variants from testable mechanism differences and preserve stable credit in a small synthetic replay?
conditions: Ten frozen synthetic objects across five predeclared case classes
Two independent reviewers blind to answer key and authors
Counterbalanced packet order and third-party adjudication

variables_or_interventions.name: novelty classification method
variables_or_interventions.planned_value: NR-01 through NR-07 on exact rule-set version

variables_or_interventions.name: source packet and cost accounting
variables_or_interventions.planned_value: Same frozen local baseline and closest-prior packet for both reviewers

variables_or_interventions.name: blind attribution replay
variables_or_interventions.planned_value: Hide contributor names before repeating credit assessment

environment: Synthetic public-source-only local pilot; no participant or employer data.
prerequisites: Freeze objects, baselines and answer key
Set pilot budget and review permission
stop_rules: Stop earlier on answer-key leakage, reviewer conflict or object-version drift
limitations: Small synthetic set cannot establish general reliability or financial fairness
claim_ceiling: Draft synthetic pilot design only; no empirical finding or run permission.
